checkRuns.command: bun run fmt >/dev/null 2>&1; git diff --stat; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -20

cat > src/routes/_layout.kay <<'EOF'
--- server
import { books } from '../content.config'

const path = ctx.url.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
const bookSlug = /^\/books\/([^/]+)$/.exec(path)?.[1]
const isBookPage = bookSlug !== undefined && (await books.get(decodeURIComponent(bookSlug))) !== undefined
const current = path === '/books' || isBookPage ? 'books' : path === '/about' ? 'about' : path === '/contact' ? 'contact' : undefined
---
header
  a(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf
  nav(aria-label="Main")
    a(href="/books" aria-current={current === 'books' ? 'page' : undefined}) Books
    a(href="/about" aria-current={current === 'about' ? 'page' : undefined}) About
    a(href="/contact" aria-current={current === 'contact' ? 'page' : undefined}) Contact
main
  slot
footer © Bookshelf
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/components/contact-form.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'
""","""import { ActionError } from 'kay'
import { send } from '../routes/contact.kay'
""")
s=s.replace("""    thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
    form.reset()
""","""    try {
      thanked.set((await send(fields, { refresh: false })).name)
      form.reset()
    }
    catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof ActionError))
        throw error
      errors.set(send.refused(error) ? error.data?.errors ?? {} : {})
    }
""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3

pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 1; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|warn" ; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; for p in /books /books/ /books/dracula /books/nope /about /about/x /contact /; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p) $(grep -o '<nav.*</nav>' /tmp/o)"; done; curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'x-kay-page: /contact' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d '{"name":"x","email":"a","message":"b"}' http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send -w ' %{http_code}\n' | head -c 600

bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i "error\|warn" ; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production setsid bun run start > /tmp/kay-server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; for p in /books /books/ /books/dracula /books/nope /about /about/x /contact /; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4701$p) $(grep -o '<nav.*</nav>' /tmp/o)"; done; curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'x-kay-page: /contact' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:4701' -d '{"name":"x","email":"a","message":"b"}' http://127.0.0.1:4701/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send -w ' %{http_code}\n' | head -c 600

kill 531; ps -o pid=,cmd= --ppid 531 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -c "error"; (PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production setsid bun run start > /tmp/kay-server2.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 3; for p in / /books /books/moby-dick /about /contact /x; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4702$p)"; done
